rules.statement: An oral agreement to waive rent for a period can be admitted as evidence if it was entered into after the lessee was unable to carry out the terms of the original lease.
rules.supporting_quote: "The agreement entered into at the time the defendant agreed to take possession was not a variation of the terms of the original lease, but was a new agreement entered into after the plaintiff had been found unable to carry out the terms of the lease. This is a verbal lease, and so long as possession is held under it, its terms must be carried out."
